_comment: Sentiment lens input: retail social buzz + analyst consensus + insider buying per ticker. STALE FAST - refresh before relying on it. social: very_bullish|bullish|neutral|bearish|very_bearish (Reddit most-mentioned + StockTwits bullish %). analyst: strong_buy|buy|hold|sell|strong_sell (+ analyst_upside_pct = avg price-target upside). insider: buying|neutral|selling. Names not listed get no sentiment lens (treated like missing data). sentiment.py/overall.py read this; they do NOT fetch it. Coverage below is the subset with fresh signal as of the date; expand by researching forums/portals/analyst data.

AAPL.note: Mega-cap 'safe haven' favored in Reddit portfolios.

ADBE.note: Net Buy with a high avg target (~$329) but post-earnings downgrades temper the tone.

AVGO.note: Consensus Buy, zero Sells; targets ~$486-580 even after the guidance-miss crash.

GE.note: 22-analyst Strong Buy (33% Strong Buy / 58% Buy), but price (~$357) sits just above the ~$351 avg target.

JNJ.note: Top-analyst Strong Buy dividend aristocrat (avg target ~$267).

JPM.note: Trending bullish on StockTwits; strong technical uptrend.

LOW.note: Strong Buy from top 13 analysts (avg target ~$267).

META.note: Consensus Strong Buy (~60 analysts, avg target ~$828) despite the AI-capex pullback.

NVDA.note: Reddit's #1 most-mentioned with bullish AI score; high beta (~2.2) -> hype-tempered.
